what: Cards stand upright while inside the central band (40~60%) of the screen. For the amount beyond the band, they sink down by 150px and tilt in 3D (per-card X axis −2~8° · Y axis −5~−7.5°, perspective 1000px). Follow duration is .6s near the band and .1s far away (power2.out), so cards passing through the band move heavily while cards far away lie down at once. Cards already on screen at open rise into place from transparent, sunk and tilted, over .6s.

options.band: Upright band (ratio of screen height) two numbers, default .4 .6
options.rx·ry: X · Y axis tilt ranges (degrees), two numbers each. Each card picks one between them, default -2 8 · 10 15 (Y uses half in reverse, so −5~−7.5°)
options.delay: Delay (s) before the first rise, default .3 — .5 after a transition like subpages

from.where: shared.js initReveal3D · .r3d card columns on every page (original SectionReveal3D)
